sentences.japanese: 我々の代表は新税の計画に異論を唱えた。
sentences.english: Our representative argued against the new tax plan.

sentences.japanese: 彼を議長に据えることに誰も異議を唱えなかった。
sentences.english: Nobody argued against choosing him as chairman.

sentences.japanese: その提案に口をそろえて反対を唱えた。
sentences.english: We said in unison that we didn't agree to the suggestion.

sentences.japanese: カミナリが光ったその後【くわばらくわばら】と唱えたもしくは、唱える人を見たことがあるだろう。
sentences.english: I expect you've chanted "kuwabara kuwabara" after a lightning flash, or have seen somebody do so.

sentences.japanese: 彼女の提案に異議を唱えるとは君も大胆だ。
sentences.english: It is bold of you to question her proposal.
